name: run_id
description: The run's id: its UTC start time and six random hex digits.

name: finished_at
description: When the run's tables were staged for publishing.

name: outcome
description: published: the run replaced the tables.

name: git_commit
description: The code's git commit, or unknown.

name: record
description: The whole run record as JSON text, as in run_record.json: inputs, mappings, config, versions, outputs and what needs attention. No cell values. Read it with PARSE_JSON(record).
